wire.github.progress: listing the repositories your GitHub login can push to…
wire.github.opt_out_names: opted out ({count, number}): {names} — bring one back: {command}
wire.github.share_empty: GitHub repositories: none yet — the share is in place, but every borrow is refused while {reason}; {remedy}
wire.github.more: … and {count, number} more — see them all: {command}
wire.github.capacity: this is more than the {count, number} one share can carry, so every borrow is refused until you pick the ones to lend with the GitHub repositories setting (search it in /settings) or opt some out
wire.github.opt_out_step: opt a repository out: {command} — devices you share with lose push to it the next time they fetch the credential, {ttl}
wire.github.source_explicit: the list you chose by hand (the GitHub repositories setting)
wire.github.source_last_good: the list fetched {ago} — GitHub repositories couldn't be listed just now{failure}, so it may be out of date
wire.github.source_enumerated: every repository this device's GitHub login can push to, listed {ago}
wire.github.which_explicit: the list you chose by hand
wire.github.which_enumerated: the list this device's GitHub login can push to
wire.github.exclude_typo: {repo} isn't in {which} — check the spelling; it's opted out anyway, in case it's added later
wire.github.exclude_unchecked: {repo} is opted out; its spelling couldn't be checked because {which} couldn't be fetched{failure}
wire.github.exclude_added: {repo} is opted out — devices you share with lose push to it the next time they fetch the credential, {ttl}
wire.github.include_typo: {repo} is no longer opted out (it isn't in {which}, so nothing else changes)
wire.github.include_unchecked: {repo} is no longer opted out; whether it's in {which} couldn't be checked{failure}
wire.github.include_added: {repo} is back in — devices you share with can push to it again the next time they fetch the credential, {ttl}
wire.github.reason_explicit: the hand-picked GitHub repositories setting names no repository once opt-outs are removed
wire.github.reason_unavailable_local: the list of repositories this device's GitHub login can push to could not be fetched{failure}, and there is no earlier list to fall back on
wire.github.reason_unavailable_remote: the list of repositories its GitHub login can push to could not be fetched{failure}, and there is no earlier list to fall back on
wire.github.reason_excluded_local: every repository this device's GitHub login can push to ({count, number}) is opted out
wire.github.reason_excluded_remote: every repository its GitHub login can push to ({count, number}) is opted out
wire.github.reason_no_repos_local: this device's GitHub login can push to no repositories
wire.github.reason_no_repos_remote: its GitHub login can push to no repositories
wire.github.remedy_explicit: add repositories to the GitHub repositories setting (search it in /settings), or explicitly return to every pushable repository minus opt-outs with {command}
wire.github.remedy_no_repos: give that GitHub login push access to a repository
wire.github.age_days: {count, plural, one {# day ago} other {# days ago}}
wire.github.failure_coverage: GitHub could not list every pushable repository
wire.github.failure_unfetched: the repository list has not been fetched yet
wire.github.failure_earlier_login: the saved list is for an earlier GitHub login
wire.github.failure_unknown_login: the login for the saved GitHub list is unknown
wire.github.readiness_unavailable: no repository listed yet{failure} — the next borrow asks GitHub, and is refused rather than widened if it cannot
wire.github.readiness_empty: no repository{opted} — a borrow would refuse rather than widen
wire.github.readiness_explicit: the list chosen by hand there{opted}
wire.github.readiness_last_good: the list fetched {ago}{opted} — that device could not list GitHub repositories at its last check{failure}
wire.github.readiness_enumerated: every repository its login can push to, listed {ago}{opted}
wire.github.readiness_list: {form, select, one {{last} ({count, number} — {source}){pointer}} other {{head} and {last} ({count, number} — {source}){pointer}}}
wire.github.borrower_unset: {owner} has no GitHub repository it can lend access for: {detail}. Fix it on {owner}; nothing was lent.
wire.github.borrower_unset_default: {owner} has no GitHub repository it can lend access for. Check {command} on {owner}; nothing was lent.
wire.github.borrower_overflow: {owner} has more GitHub repositories than one share can carry{detail}, so nothing was lent. On {owner}, pick the ones to lend with the GitHub repositories setting (search it in /settings), or opt some out with lop network credential github exclude <owner/repo>.
wire.github.wrapper_denied: {repo} isn't in the repository list the lending device provided (it may be opted out or not pushable there). Check {command} on the lending device. Only that device can change what it lends.
wire.github.usage_repo: {action} needs one repository as owner/repo, e.g. octo-org/website
wire.github.owner_overflow: {count, number} repositories; one share can carry at most {limit, number}
wire.github.reset_failed: could not complete the return to the automatic GitHub repository list ({error}); check this device’s data folder is writable, then retry {command}
